source: USDA-NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access
queries:
SELECT mu.mukey, mu.muname, l.areaname, l.areasymbol, sc.saverest, c.cokey, c.compname, c.comppct_r,
c.majcompflag, c.taxclname, c.hydgrp, c.slope_r, c.drainagecl
FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('point(-100.330986 47.581359)') k
JOIN mapunit mu ON mu.mukey = k.mukey JOIN legend l ON l.lkey = mu.lkey
JOIN sacatalog sc ON sc.areasymbol = l.areasymbol JOIN component c ON c.mukey = mu.mukey
ORDER BY c.comppct_r DESC

SELECT hzname, hzdept_r, hzdepb_r, dbthirdbar_r, wthirdbar_r, wfifteenbar_r, wsatiated_r, ksat_r,
om_r, ph1to1h2o_r, claytotal_r, silttotal_r, sandtotal_r FROM chorizon WHERE cokey = '{cokey}' ORDER BY hzdept_r
